name: Local Commander MCP

compute.name: Owner Windows workstation
compute.notes: Windows execution node and personal native runtime.

compute.name: Netcup shared VPS
compute.notes: Docker Compose project lcmcp (web and worker, no published host ports) behind the shared edge Caddy on network lcmcp_edge; host shared with Dyk (deploy/cloud/README.md).

databases.name: SQL Server (lcmcp schema)
databases.notes: External to the compose project; separate runtime and migrator identities; immutable applied migrations, no startup migration runner.

providers.name: PayPal
providers.notes: State: off. Observed in code and deploy docs: PAYPAL_ENABLED defaults to false, and deploy/cloud/README.md keeps it and COMMERCIAL_LAUNCH_APPROVED false; commerce belongs to the website release gates. The live setting is not verified.

domains.name: localcmd.app
domains.notes: Public website, account cabinet and OAuth endpoints.

backups.name: Edge configuration backup
backups.notes: Same-host backup of the shared edge Caddy state; not off-host.

backups.name: SQL backup
backups.notes: Rests on an owner statement, not on observed code, configuration or provider state: on 2026-10-04 the owner said hosting handles SQL backup (recorded in deploy/LOCALCMD_RELEASE_REPORT.md). Backup history and restore not verified.

secrets.current: Local OAuth/runtime credentials outside the repository; on the VPS a runtime environment file plus mounted application data key and OAuth signing key.
secrets.target: Keep human/local identity separated; use scoped machine identities only where remote automation requires them.
secrets.notes: Local Commander must never become the portfolio secret vault. Names only; no values.

notes: Execution model: Full Access authorizes the Windows account's capabilities, with restrictions as owner opt-out (owner decision #104 in the project; accepted as the portfolio model by netbka/engineering-platform#82). Audit stays mandatory, and no agent or model may grant itself permissions.
The engineering-platform delivery supervisor does not use Local Commander as its execution plane; workers are isolated from it.
Product focus per planning/PRODUCT_PRINCIPLES.md F1: agent performance intelligence, with execution as the enabling fabric.

ownerReserved.summary: Security defaults that materially widen execution authority.

gaps.summary: Standing approval for deploys and shared-database migrations to any destination without restriction; asked to narrow to assigned changes and own targets.
Suites run only on request and no implementer/verifier split; asked to adopt proportional, independent verification.
